[Branded Content] Can an Indian electric SUV change what we expect from a performance car?
In this PowerDrift Blockbuster, we take the Mahindra BE 6 SPORTEQ and the BE 6 Formula E Freedom Edition to a very different kind of playground, with Indian rallying legend Gaurav Gill joining us for a day of electric performance, rear-wheel drive and Drift Mode.
The BE 6 isn't just another electric SUV. With its unconventional design, Formula E-inspired details, rear-wheel-drive layout and a dedicated Drift Mode, Mahindra has built an EV that is aimed at enthusiasts as much as everyday drivers.
